column1: # The model files this project downloads and then executes, each bound to the exact bytes the
# maintainers reviewed. Issues #444 and #449; the reasoning, and the recipe for moving a pin, are
# This is the one place either fetch site takes a model's URL or digest FROM. Both read it —
# backend-init.sh (the published backend image's ENTRYPOINT) and .github/workflows/build-standalone.yml
# (the release pipeline behind the README's download link) — through scripts/model-manifest.sh.
# Spelling a huggingface.co URL at either site instead reddens ModelDownloadPinningGuardTest, which
# also requires README's hand-download URLs to be byte-equal to a row here, so they cannot drift.
# Columns, whitespace separated: id, sha256, bytes, url.
# The revision in every url is an immutable Hugging Face commit hash, never a branch name.
# Recorded 2026-09-17 against the live Hub. ADR Decision 103's "Moving a pin" says how to take a
# digest, and why the obvious header is the wrong one for a small file.
